newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH COOPERATIVE BANKS TO CHANGE DEPOSIT RATES.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH COOPERATIVE BANKS TO CHANGE DEPOSIT RATES.

text.p: The Finnish cooperative banking group said in a statement on Wednesday it would revise its deposit rate system next year and estimated that it would gain over 200 million markka in 1997 from the changes.
"The group estimates that it will gain next year over 200 million markka from the change," it said.
Interest rates would rise on some accounts but fall on others, it said.

On ordinary accounts, the interst rate would be 0.25 percent up to 30,000 markka and the Op-prime reference rate minus three percentage points on bigger deposits, however no more than 1.5 percent, it said.
